name: @ibiti/epk-sdk
description: IBITI EPK TypeScript SDK (viem): EPK v1 kernel, and EPK v2 vaults, agent sessions, timelock and guards (./v2)

scripts.sync-abi: cd .. && forge build && cd sdk && node scripts/sync-abi.mjs
scripts.build: npm run sync-abi && npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join('src','abi');const dst=path.join('dist','abi');fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src,f),path.join(dst,f));}console.log('ABI copied to',dst);"
